changes.what: Audit fix: markPaid could unlock a bigger game with a smaller size's payment if the owner raised the limit between the size check and the write. Every write of markPaid now only happens while the game is still unpaid, open and at the limit the size was worked out from (cap=?); otherwise it refuses for certain and writes nothing.

Invite by ID only. The list takes one ID per person (letters and digits; A-1101, A 1101 and A/1101 are the same). No names or mobile numbers are asked, stored or shown for guests. A person not on the list waits for the organizer's yes or no. The join page has one ID box and a nickname box.

changes.what: Audit fixes for 1.5.3. The count of wrong typed IDs is one atomic write that returns the new number, so a burst of requests cannot get past the limit. A right (listed) ID is never counted or stopped, so an office behind one address, or a stranger who sent many wrong IDs, cannot block listed people. One address adds at most its own limit to the game count, so it cannot lock the whole game. Over the limit nothing is added to the waiting list.
The footer of every public page shows the version number and links to the What's new page (/changes.html), which says in plain words what changed in each version.
changes.where: apps/web/public/changes.html, the footer of the public pages, pages/build.mjs

changes.what: Audit fixes for 1.5.4. The guess limit counts an IPv6 address by its /64, so changing address inside one line no longer gives a fresh count. The help text no longer says nobody can guess their way in: it says an ID is matched against the list, not proven, and that the organizer can see who joined and remove a seat. The version number and the What's new link are on every public page.

changes.what: Public pages can be hidden with one switch. With SITE_HIDDEN set to 1 (a Cloudflare Pages variable, no rebuild) the landing page and the sales pages (/, /index, /about, /brochure, /pricing, /trust, /organizer-guide and the how-it-works pages) show a short 'This game is coming soon' page with a link to home.corporatetambola.com, send noindex (meta tag and X-Robots-Tag), and /llms.txt and /sitemap.xml answer 404; that page has no schema, no Open Graph and no agree buttons. Join links (/j/...), the player page, the host and organizer pages, sign-in, payment return, the legal pages, /api and the console links are NOT touched, so people who already have a link or a game still play. Switch off or unset: nothing changes. Nothing is deleted.
